How Pico POS works?

Experience the seamless power of Pico POS and get your online business managed with 3 simple and easy to follow steps.

Install the App

Get started by downloading the app. Fast, lightweight, and built to run smoothly on standard mobile and desktop operating systems.

Setup your profile

Configure your business profile, add your inventory categories, define tax structures, and personalize user permissions to match your business workflow.

Enjoy the features!

Start ringing up sales, tracking inventory, processing payments, and analyzing performance instantly.

Quickly deploy Pico POS on any supported device. Enjoy a highly responsive interface designed for seamless offline-online sync, for optimum speed.
